patches.reason: Legacy bug (creator report): after the player's school photo was uploaded, a line left over from testing, getBoolean(loadBoolean("Sch.SchoolPictureTaken")) at the left margin, put the flag just saved (true) to the player as a yes/no question whose answer nothing used. Remove it.
The player's own reply, shown as a message in legacy, is a button (owner 2026-10-15; provisional).

Legacy bug (creator report): a task list reads toys.nippleclamps; the toy chest saves nipple clamps as toys.nipple_clamps, and nothing saves the other spelling, so "put on nipple clamps" never joined the list. Read toys.nipple_clamps.

Legacy bug (creator report): two gym tasks read toys.ice; the toy chest and this script's own toy screen save the ice tray as toys.ice_tray, and nothing saves toys.ice, so the ice tasks never joined the lists. Read toys.ice_tray.
